pages.text: Defensive barriers have a level from their spell level (1-5). A spell striking one compares its level with the shield's:$(li)clearly stronger: the shield shatters from the point of impact
pages.title: Breaking Defensive Magic

pages.text: $(li)about equal: the spell is cancelled in a white flash and the shield wears$(li)weaker: the shield holds, cracking more with each hit

Physical spells (Balgrant, Doragate, golem fist) count as two levels higher. Your own shield never blocks your own spells.$(br2)Examination barriers cannot be broken this way: only the Barrier Breaker can open one.
